title: The full Roos identity from its two coordinate equations
statement: In an abelian category with countable products let F be an additive endofunctor and a:F≅Id. Let C be a strict tower of cochain complexes, and r:F_complex(Roos(C))→Roos(C⋙F_complex) have the projection-normalized first and second Roos coordinates. Then r followed by Roos of the tower of degreewise a components equals the degreewise a component on Roos(C). Both coordinates of the whole cone map are retained. The constructions and notation are those of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined].

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.

proof.text: The product comparison followed by the product of the a components is the a component at the product: check each projection by naturality. The existing RoosMap coordinate equations and the two hypotheses on r reduce both coordinates of the desired equality to this product equation and naturality of a. In degree i, mappingCocone.id_X expresses identity as the sum of its two projection-inclusion composites, so equality of both coordinates gives equality of the full cochain maps.

theorem podIdentityRoosMap
    {A : Type*} [Category A] [Abelian A] [HasCountableProducts A]
    (F : A ⥤ A) [F.Additive] (a : F ≅ 𝟭 A)
    (C : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (r : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (integralOperationsRoos C) ⟶
      integralOperationsRoos (C ⋙ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)))
    (hf : r ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
        (podRoosBoundary (C ⋙ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) =
      (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (podRoosBoundary C)) ≫
          piComparison (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) (fun n : ℕ ↦ C.obj (op n)))
    (hs : ∀ i : ℤ, r.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
        (podRoosBoundary (C ⋙ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)))).v
          i (i - 1) (by omega) =
      F.map ((CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (podRoosBoundary C)).v
        i (i - 1) (by omega)) ≫
        (piComparison (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ C.obj (op n))).f (i - 1)) :
    let α := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso _ (.up ℤ)
    r ≫ integralOperationsRoosMap
        (isoWhiskerLeft C α ≪≫ C.rightUnitor).hom =
      α.hom.app (integralOperationsRoos C)
